title: About
text: The examples posted on this site are for introductory statistics used while teaching. They are not comprehensive (nor 100% error free), but serve the purpose of either showcasing important examples (e.g. results of a “not-so-random” test) or interactive learning (e.g. heatmaps of random sampling) that students can edit live through their web browser.
